questions.question: Which cable type supports a maximum length of 100 meters (328 feet) for 10Gbps speeds under optimal conditions?
questions.explanation: Cat 6a supports 10 Gbps speeds up to 100 meters. Standard Cat 6 supports 10 Gbps up to only 55 meters.

questions.question: Which expansion slot standard uses point-to-point serial connections called 'lanes'?
questions.explanation: PCI Express (PCIe) uses dedicated point-to-point serial communication lanes (x1, x4, x8, x16).

questions.question: Which Windows command line utility is used to check and repair file system corruption on a disk drive?
questions.explanation: chkdsk checks the file system and file system metadata of a volume for logical and physical errors.
